Khronos glTF Sample Assets [Fox](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/4995a638c96dbc94376d3d6164e70fee3ac7f7a2/Models/Fox). This fixture is the original, unmodified GLB.

The model is by PixelMannen (2014), [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The rigging and animation are by tomkranis (2014), and the glTF conversion is by Asobo Studio and scurest (2017), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
